prediction_population.species: same exact v1.163 fixed bird universe

R3_add: pilot-only log1p nearest Euclidean occupied-source distance
C_actual_add: pilot-only log1p nearest actual-graph path to occupied source
reference_ladder.C_null_add: same two graph-path features recomputed separately on each of the exact 20 v1.162 null graphs
reference_ladder.critical_invariant: R0, R1, R2 and R3 are identical for actual C and every null C; rewiring changes only the two C graph-path source features

source_rules.pilot_training_row: exclude focal pilot island from its occupied-source set
source_rules.confirmatory_prediction_row: use all six pilot islands and no confirmatory bird value
source_rules.pressure_kernel_scale: exact actual-operator kernel scale frozen at v1.162 for actual and all null graph path pressures
source_rules.euclidean_features: computed from frozen 19-island coordinates and unchanged across topology models

standardization.base_R0_R2: reuse committed response-independent v0.99/actual-graph values; population z-scoring rules unchanged
standardization.R3_species_features: population z-score over complete pilot training rows, common to all models
standardization.actual_C_features: population z-score over complete pilot training rows for actual topology
standardization.each_null_C_features: population z-score over complete pilot training rows for that null topology
standardization.zS: use the exact v1.163 frozen mean and population SD over the complete confirmatory S surface; no restandardization after confirmatory access

fitting.solver: same deterministic IRLS plus pivoted Gaussian elimination as completed boreal beetle route

primary_scoring.block_weight: within each presence-bearing frozen spatial block, cell weights sum to one
primary_scoring.estimand: weighted least-squares slope beta_S in D = alpha + beta_S*zS
primary_scoring.bootstrap_rule: resample presence-bearing block IDs with replacement; each draw of a block contributes that block with total weight one; refit weighted slope
primary_scoring.unestimable_rule: terminal non-estimable if fewer than four presence-bearing blocks or weighted zS denominator is zero; no rescue

secondary_nonrescuing: equal-block mean D among realized presences
count of 20 null C models worse than actual C on equal-block realized-presence loss
all-cell beta_S under the same frozen prediction surface
descriptive beta_S by n category without inferential rescue

claim_boundary.positive_result_can_support: same-geography cross-taxon support for the prediction that sparse heterogeneous source configurations are where exact topology carries extra occurrence information
cannot_support: reversal of the completed beetle primary
